note: Set A is better because it captures document metadata (revisions, lot number) and most notes correctly without inventing data, whereas Set B hallucinates non-existent wire symbols (101, 105, 106) and misattributes the sub-panel main breaker capacity (200A vs 50A). Set A does struggle with wire specifications due to text layer noise (e.g., Symbol 50 material, Symbol 10 spec), but these misreads are less severe than inventing components or getting safety-critical ratings wrong.
